02 / Artist

Painting the
familiar.

Jovan Benito is a Filipino contemporary painter from Laguna whose practice centers on the warmth, color, and beauty of everyday Filipino life.

Growing up with her father's work as a sign artist, Benito developed an early appreciation for visual language and the familiar scenes around her. Her paintings carry this influence through expressive figures, vivid color, patterned clothing, and scenes shaped by community and tradition.

As a mother, Benito is especially drawn to moments of togetherness, from visiting local markets and gathering flowers to family celebrations and ordinary days spent with loved ones.

“The everyday becomes a memory worth keeping.”
